title: 3D Product Showcase - Sports Memorabilia
desc: 3D product showcase for a sports memorabilia commerce concept. An exploration of how collectible sports items can be presented through immersive visuals and product-focused storytelling. The project focuses on digital presentation, composition, and material design - creating a premium experience around rare and valuable objects. Designed to evoke a sense of exclusivity and timeless value in a digital environment.

title: E-commerce Experience for a Smart Bike Brand
desc: BikeOn is a smart mobility brand combining performance engineering with connected technology. We designed and developed an image-driven product website focused on clearly explaining the device, bicycles and their ecosystem. The goal was to translate complex technical features into a bold, structured and engaging digital experience. Scope included UX strategy, UI design, custom 3D models of the device and bicycles, and full web development. The result is a scalable digital platform built to communicate innovation, clarity and brand confidence.

title: Product Visualization & Amazon Listing Design
desc: This project was created for Mushroom Genetics, a supplement brand focused on functional mushroom products. Our team developed a complete set of visual assets to support the product launch, including 3D product modeling, high-quality product visualizations, Amazon listing graphics, and advertising creatives. The goal was to create a clear, modern, and trustworthy product presentation suitable for e-commerce platforms and digital marketing campaigns. The visual system helped the brand establish a professional presence across Amazon, advertising platforms, and their official website.

title: Skinz — Visual System for an In-App Marketplace
desc: We developed the visual identity and product experience for a digital marketplace integrated within a messaging platform. The project included creating a cohesive brand system, designing the store interface for a fast and intuitive browsing experience inside the app and developing a stylized animated lootbox to add excitement and reward-driven interaction. The final result combines branding, store UI, and motion design into a unified marketplace experience that feels dynamic, engaging, and native to the messenger environment.
